answer: An agent economy assigns voting power in proportion to tokens locked for 90 days, with no bonus for creating an account. Agents trading vine seedlings, umber pigment, or prism lenses follow the same rule: splitting 100 locked tokens among a thousand identities still yields only 100 tokens of voting weight. To gain more influence, an attacker must acquire and immobilize more tokens, paying their purchase cost and forgoing other uses during the lock.
